title: Associate - Hydrogeology
description:
Hydrogeological skills of managing data, Risk Assessment modelling using ConSim, RTM and LandSim, preparing technical reports relating to the interpretation of hydrogeological conditions. Delegation of work to junior team members with oversight and direction.


  
The successful applicant would be responsible for many of the following:  



* Communicating and liaising effectively and efficiently with the UK Ground and Water project team (team members, project managers and directors).
* Undertake bid preparation, resource and budget development.
* Line manage and support the professional development of early career professionals.
* Contribute to recruitment and growth of the GCC Hydrogeology team.
* Project and task management.
* Good presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Understanding of the land contamination and regulatory regime within the UK and the risk\-based approach to the assessment of land contamination.
* Managing hydrogeological data and developing hydrogeological conceptual models and interpretation based on the data.
* Developing source\-pathway\-receptor linkages and risk assessment modelling to support the preparation of hydrogeological risk assessments and detailed quantitative risk assessments for contaminated land and landfill.
* Use and learn software such as ConSim, LandSim, P20, FeFlow, Modflow, SeepW
* Undertaking / performing project tasks assigned by senior people in the team.
* Preparing and reviewing factual and interpretive reports.
* Take ownership for aspects of project delivery including delegation to and oversight of junior team members, technical, quality, schedule and budget.
* Build relationships with our Clients to ensure that our services deliver project outcomes and customer satisfaction.

Experience


* \>10 Years of Industry experience is desirable.
* Experience the UK environmental consulting is desirable.

  
* Postgraduate qualification (MTech, MSc and or PhD) in hydrogeology or a hydrogeological discipline.
* Chartership with an appropriate geoscience organisation.

title: Director, Software Development
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti\-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.


We are seeking an accomplished **Software Development Director** to join the OneSpan India Software group in Noida. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience leading enterprise software product and cloud engineering teams, with a strong track record of delivering products using agile methodologies. He / She should have experience managing teams of 20\-40 engineers and be passionate about building high\-quality software products in fast\-paced, AI First and evolving environments. The right candidate should be passionate about software and technology product development, excellent communicator, comfortable with ambiguous environments, and can move fast, bring people and technology together.


### **About the Role**



Software Development Director is responsible for co\-developing the vision and leading software product development teams in a specific site. He/she develops and communicates the strategic direction for the software teams He/she has final accountability for the delivery, the performance \& the people leadership of the different squads. He/she works closely with various teams to maximize engagement and defines skill growth and location strategies


*Specific details about the role are as follows:*


* Lead engineering teams responsible for the OneSpan Cyber Security Suite and cloud services deployed on AWS.


* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and DevOps leaders across global teams to define and adopt scalable architectures, engineering standards, and best practices.


* Own software delivery, execution, quality, and engineering effectiveness.


* Provide leadership that drives collaboration, innovation, and organizational growth.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


#### **Thought Leadership:**


* Identify emerging technology trends and assess their impact on the business.


* Contribute to technology strategy and prioritize engineering initiatives aligned with business goals.


* Establish and promote engineering methodologies, standards, and best practices.


#### **People Leadership:**


* Develop engineering talent and foster high\-performing, engaged teams.


* Build organizational capabilities aligned with future business and technology needs.


* Support people processes including performance management, talent development, onboarding, and workforce planning.


#### **Results Leadership:**


* Deliver product features and releases efficiently while maintaining quality and scalability.


* Drive accountability for engineering outcomes with an AI\-first mindset and adoption of AI\-assisted development practices.


### **About the Successful Candidate**



The successful candidate is a self\-motivated leader who can deal with complex problems, has a vision to take the organization to the next level. He/She should be able to understand complex security domain including key protocols in identity management and authentication. The candidate must be experienced in developing applications as well and should be able to understand the complexities of software development for on\-premise products and cloud services.


### **Preferred Skills and Experience:**



We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains:


* B.S/M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related technical discipline


* At least 15\-20 years of experience in building Enterprise software products and Cloud Services out of which last 5\-7 years in Software Development Manager responsibilities.


* Prior experience in Leading product and cloud technology teams across diverse technology stack on C\+\+/Node.js/Java preferably Multi\-tenant SaaS/PaaS Services using microservices architecture on any of the cloud environments AWS/Azure/Oracle Public Cloud.


* Must be familiar with containers technologies and ideally should be exposed to any of the full stack technology stack.


* Should have high emotional quotient, self\-driven and shows technology leadership in complex and ambiguous situations.

title: Senior Manager AI or ML Engineering
description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI strategies, with a primary focus on marketing\-related business domains. Knowledge of the end\-to\-end content supply chain is preferred
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and execute AI/ML initiatives that drive business outcomes
* Design, build, and deploy scalable AI/ML and Generative AI solutions that address complex business challenges
* Drive innovation through hands\-on development and continuous adoption of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies
* Lead the integration of AI/ML capabilities into products and platforms while promoting best practices across the development lifecycle
* Leverage Agile and DevSecOps practices to enable automated, continuous delivery across the complete AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), from code check\-in to production deployment
* Develop and optimize solutions utilizing technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, and model fine\-tuning
* Mentor teams and contribute to the development of AI engineering capabilities, standards, and governance
* Work across cloud environments to architect, deploy, and manage AI solutions on platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Continuously evaluate and implement new tools, languages, frameworks, and approaches to enhance AI/ML solution delivery
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline
* 12\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, or related fields
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML Engineering or related domains
* 3\+ years of recent experience focused on Generative AI technologies, including:
	+ OpenAI
	+ Claude
	+ Gemini
	+ LangChain
	+ AI Agents
	+ Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector Databases
	+ Prompt Engineering
	+ Model Fine\-tuning
* Technical Skills
	+ Solid hands\-on expertise in AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solution development
	+ Experience with AI/ML frameworks and tools such as:
		- MLflow
		- TensorFlow
		- PyTorch
		- Keras
		- Scikit\-learn
	+ Experience working with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
	+ Deep understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation across the AI lifecycle
	+ Proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages used for AI/ML development and data analysis

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in marketing technology, digital marketing analytics, or customer engagement platforms
* Understanding of content creation, management, and distribution ecosystems across the content supply chain
* Proven track record of delivering innovative AI\-driven products and enterprise\-scale machine learning solutions

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior AI Architect
description:
Qualification:
**Senior AI Architect**
-----------------------


We are seeking an accomplished Senior AI Architect to lead the end\-to\-end design and deployment of cutting\-edge AI solutions at enterprise scale. Leveraging your deep expertise in generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and AWS, you will shape strategic AI initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and ensure our solutions deliver transformative business value. If you thrive on turning complex challenges into elegant, scalable architectures and enjoy working in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment, we invite you to join our forward\-thinking organization.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Architect and own the design of enterprise\-grade AI solutions, with a primary focus on generative AI, LLMs, and RAG pipelines.


* Define and maintain AI/ML architecture standards, best practices, and governance models aligned with business objectives.


* Collaborate with product, data science, engineering, and DevOps teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures.


* Lead end\-to\-end solution delivery on AWS, covering data ingestion, model training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.


* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and frameworks, providing strategic recommendations for adoption.


* Mentor and guide cross\-functional teams on AI architecture, coding standards, and cloud best practices.


* Ensure security, compliance, performance, and cost optimization across all AI workloads.


* Present architectural solutions and roadmaps to executive stakeholders, articulating value and ROI.


* Drive POCs and pilot projects to validate architectural approaches and accelerate innovation.


* Create and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation, playbooks, and knowledge\-sharing resources.


**Requirements:**
-----------------


* 15–19 years of overall technology experience, with at least 5 years in AI/ML architecture and solution design.


* Proven track record architecting and deploying generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (e.g., GPT, Llama, PaLM) and Retrieval Augmented Generation techniques.


* Deep expertise in AWS services relevant to AI/ML (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, etc.).


* Strong programming proficiency in Python and experience with ML/AI frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers).


* Comprehensive understanding of data engineering, feature stores, MLOps, CI/CD, and monitoring for AI pipelines.


* Demonstrated ability to define architecture standards, patterns, and best practices in large, complex environments.


* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with experience influencing executive leadership.


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.


**Nice to Have:**
-----------------


* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow).


* Familiarity with multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud strategies (Azure, GCP) in AI deployments.


* Knowledge of responsible AI, model interpretability, and AI ethics frameworks.


* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or published research in reputable conferences/journals.


* Industry experience in domains such as finance, healthcare, or manufacturing with regulated environments.


Skills Required:
Ai Architect, generative ai, Large Language Model, Retrieval Augmented Generation, AWS, Gen AI architect, SageMaker, Bedrock


Role:
About the Role:
  

As an AI Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing advanced AI solutions that meet business needs. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define project requirements and translate them into scalable architectures. Your expertise will guide technical decisions and ensure the integrity of AI systems throughout the development lifecycle.
  

  

About the Team:
  

You will be part of a dynamic team of machine learning engineers, Gen AI engineers and software developers. The team values innovation and encourages collaboration to drive cutting\-edge AI projects. You will interact with various departments, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement as you work towards shared goals.
  

  

You are Responsible for:
  

* Developing AI system architectures that are robust, scalable, and maintainable.
* Evaluating and selecting appropriate AI technologies and tools for projects.
* Leading the design and implementation of machine learning models and algorithms.
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices in AI development.

  

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
  

* Extensive experience in artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, along with experience in relevant frameworks.
* Proven track record of designing and deploying AI solutions in production environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically about complex challenges.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

15\.0 to 19\.0 years
